item.title: Re: Explanation wanted.
item.content:encoded:
I'd recommend reading over discussion threads if you've got questions about the article. In this case, at least two people have indicated that there is no explanation for this thing's existence.

That said, there's no requirement for an SCP's origin. If the author doesn't add it, then it's up to the reader to think of it, if they're so inclined.

I rather like the mystery, in this case.
